next.reason: 1985: 'Format 3 is the file description entry for a report file', its availability 'dependent on whether the Report Writer module is supported'. 2023 §2023:13.4.5.3 SR8: 'Format 3 is the file description entry for a report file'; the availability dependency is retained, not dropped (mode b): §2023:A.4.11 lists 'File description entry, format 3: report (13.4.5)' as an optional Report Writer element, and §2023:4.2.7 says such elements an implementor 'may, but need not, implement'. Same. Catalog note: 4.2.7 and A.4.11 have no catalog ids, so they cannot appear in 'to'.
